fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. A finishing thrust deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Brought to Ground
fusions.desc: Hurls a spike at the first enemy it meets within 9 tiles, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Quarry in Sight
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Wounded Prey
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
